t: You're looking at the Theatre Royal, Drury Lane, a Grade One listed West End theatre in Covent Garden. The building faces Catherine Street and backs onto Drury Lane. The present building opened in 1812, and it is the latest of four theatres on this spot since 1663, which makes it the oldest theatre site in London still in use. Thomas Killigrew, a dramatist and theatre manager at the court of Charles the Second, founded it. Christopher Wren is named as its designer. The actor John Palmer died here.
